name: The Obsession
source:
With your school days fading into the past and adulthood closing in, you’ll meet three unique heroines. Their fates depend solely on your decisions: who will live, who will die, or can you keep all of them alive?

[From [url=https://via-project.itch.io/the-obsession]Itch.io[/url]]
